policy.o72Application: Owner decisions O72-O127 (2026-10-26 to 2026-10-29): after the O71 search found no model × tier with two concordant user reports, the owner-authorised routes stay (the SemiAnalysis selection with its O40/O45 assumptions, the O46 MiMo quota ceilings) and providers without one (Google, Kimi, MiniMax) stay on API fallback. Two concordant user reports replace only an assumption-based or fallback route; an exact controlled measurement keeps precedence (O73) unless a detected change flags it and a concordant pair for the same plan is dated after that change (O78). Admission stays the strict all-reports concordance test (O74); every release runs all three O71 stages over every cell (O75); speed-mode reports convert at the provider's multiplier, flagged (O76); a provider's announcement of a change to a plan's limits or price triggers E18 (O77 as amended by O101; a metering-only announcement flags nothing); a change to a shared meter flags every plan on it (O79); a 5-hour figure stays in its own unit (O80) and never converts (O82); a provider-documented change to limits or price splits the partition too (O83, O99); a change detected on any Kimi plan splits every Kimi plan (O84); every report cell is tested, and one on a plan the Plan ranking does not list is evidence only (O85). O86: concordance is the largest lower bound at most 1.20x the smallest upper bound. O87: an allowance is effort-invariant, so reports pool across efforts of one model. O88: a SemiAnalysis figure for a model serves every effort of that model, labelled; O90 counts it as measured evidence. O89: an O88 same-model route shares its donor measurement's precedence and change flag against reports for the same model and plan. O91, O92: a controlled measurement inside an acknowledged accounting-fault window for its plan stays selected and flagged, with the routes resting on it, until two concordant user reports for that plan replace it. O93: a report pair replaces only its own model's fault-flagged route. O94: a row whose AA cost omits a pricing term competes over its published cost up to the stated factor and earns no label. O95: a lower-of transfer re-takes the lower of its plan's effective figures at every release. O96: every other transfer and O88 route takes its own donor's replacing figure. O97: an O88 route that follows its donor to a report pair takes the pair's whole measurement record and its grade. O98: a factorless AA cost caveat competes over [C, ∞) instead of leaving outputs unresolved. O99: only a change to a plan's limits or price splits the report partition; a metering-only announcement is logged. O100: AA chart footnotes are classified once in a register by exact text, and the build stops on a new or changed one. O101: a metering-only announcement flags no route either. O102: routes resting on a demoted donor measurement follow that model's admitted report pair on the same plan. O103: the footnote register covers the Intelligence Index chart's footnotes now, and the notes on model pages, the Coding Agent Index and cost charts from the next AA capture. O104: a lower-of transfer takes the lower of its plan's eligible figures; a demoted measurement no report pair replaced drops out. With no eligible figure left, that transfer keeps its stored donor and is diagnostic with it (O104). O105: a model-availability change flags the plan's routes without splitting the report partition. O106: a registered pricing omission on any AA surface makes the row an O94 row. O107: an availability-only flag prints the label only; it blocks no label and gives no report pair precedence, and a later limit or price change still blocks. O108, O109: O106 counts, per ranking, only the cost charts and index admitted to that ranking's cost workload. O110: a measurement's span starts no earlier than its model's launch on the plan or the schedule it says it ran under; a change on that start day is part of the measured regime. O111: a bundled credit grant flags and blocks like a limit change without splitting the report partitions. O112: a reading spanning a provider's global meter reset is excluded; a reset flags nothing. O113: a change record may name a meter family, which reaches every plan on that meter, tier-unstated and redacted plans included. O115: a passing cell's pooled value clips each report's midpoint to the concordance band [largest lower bound / 1.20, 1.20 x smallest upper bound] before the geometric mean. A hard-expired route (in grace) and a route measured inside an acknowledged accounting-fault window compete in the Plan interval outputs as blockers that earn no label (O118, O119). A form-submitted report counts only with a hashed evidence artifact, and a passing cell needs a report the staged search found (O124); an admitted report pair ages like a measurement after the window (O127); a cross-effort route is measured only on a tokens or credits meter (O126). The selected SemiAnalysis article is re-read before each release and the read recorded under its source evidence (O130); O112 stands for OpenAI's resetting meter (O131). GPT-6.1 Terra, new to the cohort with the AA Intelligence Index v5 re-capture (O132), takes the O45 lower-of transfer on every ChatGPT plan; Gemini 4 Carbon uses API-cost fallback; Anthropic's 2026-10-30 renames (Max 5x to Max, Max 20x to Ultra) are dated plan aliases, with Ultra's five-hour removal recorded as a limit change.
